text: THE DBIM SCHEMES AND SERVICES PAGE LISTS THE LIVE WEBSITE'S SCHEMES. Its 28 schemes, names, groups and "Who It Is For" are the Department's own listing (dosje.gov.in, read 29 Sep 2026; `lib/website-shared/scheme-listing.ts`), in Title Case with four spelling and spacing repairs recorded beside them; the Category select offers the live site's eleven groups in its order. Every card carries the live listing's one scheme image, byte-for-byte and under DBIM 3.0 A.5.2.1's 100 KB; the reference's stock photographs and portal logos are removed. The nine schemes the scheme master does not hold (AVYAY, SMILE, PM-YASASVI and six more) get a page built from the Department's own page and documents, so every card opens one.
